_comment: THE ROSTER. This is the only hand-edited file in the awards system besides
badges.json. scripts/build_api.py turns the two into the public endpoints
under api/v1/ and the Wall of Fame at wall.html.
Adding an award: append to that member's `badges` with the badge id, the date,
and the `discussion` URL where it was approved — that thread is where people
comment and upvote, so the award has a public record, not just a row here.
Revoking: set the member's status to 'revoked' (whole account) or drop the
single badge and note it. NEVER delete a member entry — the endpoint URL must
keep resolving so an embedded badge flips to 'not certified' instead of
breaking. A 404 is indistinguishable from an outage; an explicit answer is not.
Usernames are matched case-insensitively (GitHub is) and stored lowercase.
Roles, not personal data: username, badges, dates, public links. No emails.

levels.certified: Has published at least one agent to the library that passed review.
levels.maintainer: Certified, and reviews submissions from other publishers.

members.note: Library maintainer account — the reference entry.
